title: test(dogfood): drop the registrar-file list's length pin from authz-conformance
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9A5x8a8TEjH8k1vYVW1iwVG)_
Fixes #26524

Part of #26431

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：`packages/qa/dogfood/test/authz-conformance.test.ts` 删掉「注册器文件清单长度 = 18」这条手抄断言，同一个 case 的其它断言全部保留；`packages/rest/src/rest-server-registrar-files.ts` 头注里「每个读者都钉清单长度」这句话改成实情。只改测试和一段注释，不发布任何东西。
- 为什么改：清单本身就是权威，这个数字每拆一个路由模块出 `rest-server.ts` 就要改一次，而 PR CI 不跑 dogfood，所以拆分 PR 自己看不到，合入后 `main` 才变红。#26518 已经删了 `packages/rest` 里的六处，这是第七处（维护者在退役检查清扫里「同意」）。
- 风险与回滚：只删一条断言。实测空清单、探针漏读一个文件、探针少读一个文件这三种情况，这个 case 都照样变红；回滚就是 revert 这一个 commit。
- 先看：`authz-conformance.test.ts` 第 1624–1659 行（这个 case），然后是 `rest-server-registrar-files.ts` 第 23–26 行。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood exec vitest run test/authz-conformance.test.ts`（要先建好 dogfood 的依赖闭包），预期 60/60 全绿。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- `authz-conformance.test.ts`, case "reads ZERO on the real rest-server.ts today (the pre-wiring baseline)": `expect(REST_SERVER_REGISTRAR_FILES).toHaveLength(18)` is deleted. Everything else the case asserts stays: `REST_SERVER_REGISTRAR_PATHS[0]` is `rest-server.ts`; both probes' `alsoReads` equal the list minus its head, and `probeSource` equals the listed files joined in order; zero hits over the list; no `realtime:rest-server.ts:` tripwire key is minted.
- The case's comment said the list's "length is pinned so a module added to it makes this re-read". That clause is now false, so it is cut. The fifteen `Length N → M` history lines stay, and one closing `[#26524]` line follows them.
- No `toBeGreaterThan(0)` guard is added. On an empty list the case already reds at `REST_SERVER_REGISTRAR_PATHS[0]` (measured below).
- `rest-server-registrar-files.ts` header, lines 23–26: "Each reader keeps its own sum over the list and pins the list's `length`" was true of seven readers before #26518 and #26520. After this PR, none pins it. The sentence now says that each reader keeps its own sum, that none pins the length, and that a module added to the list widens every reader with no edit to any of them. #26436 landed (PR #26520) before this PR opened, so the reword rides here as the card ordered.

## Why

The list file's own header says it is ⛔ not a gate and that each reader stays the authority on what it counts. The length pin made the dogfood suite red on every registrar move, for a number nothing is derived from. Dogfood is skipped on PR CI, so the split PR never saw the red; `main`'s push battery did, after the merge. This follows #26431's rule as applied to the six `packages/rest` copies in #26518.

## Verification

All runs are on head `55b1b414` (base `f486e9c1`), after the dogfood dependency closure was built: `pnpm --workspace-concurrency=2 --filter '@objectstack/dogfood^...' build`, lock `VERDICT command-exit 0`.

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 test/authz-conformance.test.ts test/authz-probe-blind-spot.test.ts`: `Test Files 2 passed (2)`, `Tests 70 passed (70)`, VERDICT exit 0. `authz-conformance.test.ts` alone: 60/60.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood --filter @objectstack/rest run typecheck`: VERDICT exit 0. Both tsc programs list the changed file (`--listFilesOnly`: 1 hit each).
- Acceptance grep: `git grep -n "REGISTRAR_FILES).toHaveLength" -- packages/qa` gives no hit (exit 1).
- Dogfood is skipped on PR CI (it runs only on `main` push and schedule runs), so the local run above is the evidence for this suite.

<details><summary>Empty list: the case still reds, so no anti-vacuity guard is added</summary>

`REST_SERVER_REGISTRAR_FILES` was replaced with an empty array in `rest-server-registrar-files.ts`, using `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`. The output was `ok mutation landed: anchor 1 -> 0`, then `ok restored: blob == HEAD (020a438009c3) and git diff HEAD is empty`. The dogfood test imports the list from `src/` by relative path, so no `dist/` sits on the path and no rebuild is needed per leg.

Result: `Tests 1 failed | 59 passed (60)`. The red is this case at `authz-conformance.test.ts:1647`: `expected undefined to be 'packages/rest/src/rest-server.ts'`.
</details>

<details><summary>Ablation: a probe that skips a listed file reds the case</summary>

| Leg | Mutation (`ablation-replace`, anchor 1 → 0, restored to the HEAD blob) | Result |
|:--|:--|:--|
| B1, `alsoReads` skips `ui-routes.ts` | `REST_SERVER_REGISTRAR_ALSO_READS` filter gains `&& !file.endsWith('/ui-routes.ts')` | `Tests 1 failed / 59 passed`: this case, at line 1650 (`expected [ …(16) ] to deeply equal [ …(17) ]`) |
| B2, `probeSource` reads one file fewer | `probe.alsoReads` is read with `.slice(1)` before `.map` in `probeSource` | `Tests 1 failed / 59 passed`: this case, at line 1651 (the probe-text equality) |
</details>

<details><summary>Dry move: a name appended to the list stays green here</summary>

Probe: a new `packages/rest/src/zz-dry-move-routes.ts` (licence header and `export {};`, no route body) is appended to `REST_SERVER_REGISTRAR_FILES`, making the list length 19. The append went through `ablation-replace --hold` (`ok mutation landed: anchor 1 -> 0`) under an EXIT/INT/TERM restore trap. Afterwards both files hash to their HEAD blobs, the probe module is removed, `git diff HEAD` is empty and `git status` is clean.

| Leg | Result |
|:--|:--|
| this head | `authz-conformance.test.ts` 60/60 green. `authz-probe-blind-spot.test.ts` reds one case, "every module on the RestServer registrar list still registers routes": the probe module has no route body. That case asserts a fact about each listed module, not a count; a real registrar module satisfies it. |
| base test file (pin in), same list | `Tests 1 failed / 59 passed`: `expected [ 'rest-server.ts', …(18) ] to have a length of 18 but got 19` at line 1646 |

The first attempt at this leg was a no-op. The anchor `'meta-object-state-routes.ts',` occurs twice in the list file, and `ablation-replace` refused it (`ANCHOR AMBIGUOUS`, exit 3; on-disk count 0). The two readings taken in that pass are discarded. The table above is the rerun with a unique anchor.
</details>

<details><summary>Gates</summary>

Head `55b1b414`. Derivation: `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` gave 53 commands. Each one ran with stdin closed, and its exit code was captured before any pipe.

- 51 of 53 exited 0 on the first pass.
- `node scripts/check-plugin-teardown-shape.mjs --self-test` exited 3 (PREREQUISITE NOT MET: the pinned fixture commit `621a4876` was missing from the shallow clone). After `git fetch --depth=1 origin` of that sha it exited 0: "48 cases pass".
- `pnpm check:dual-build-cjs-loads` exited 3 (PREREQUISITE NOT MET: no `dist` for six packages outside the dogfood closure). After `turbo run build --concurrency=2 --filter='./packages/**'` (lock VERDICT exit 0) it exited 0: "112 published require entry point(s) across 69 package(s) load".
- `--ran` reconciliation: "53 derived, 53 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN", a DERIVED zero.
- The families the derivation places outside its list (artifact rosters, wide populations, path-scheduled CI jobs, type-check lanes) are CI's run on this PR. The dogfood jobs among them do not run on a PR.
</details>

## Acceptance notes

- `authz-probe-blind-spot.test.ts:155` already carries `expect(REST_SERVER_REGISTRAR_FILES.length).toBeGreaterThan(0)`, so dogfood keeps one anti-vacuity guard on the list either way.
- Changeset: none. The diff touches a dogfood test (private package) and a comment in a `src/` file that `src/index.ts` never reaches (it is not in `dist`), so nothing published changes. `skip-changeset` is set at creation.

## Human Minimum

- [x] 1. Schemas start as Zod; `packages/spec` holds no runtime logic. (not touched)
- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind. (no names added)
- [x] 3. No formatter ran; `pnpm lint` passes. (no formatter ran; lint is CI's run)
- [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request.
- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset, and both declaration lines are filled in here and in the changeset. (publishes nothing; both lines are above)
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: its generated artifacts are regenerated and committed. (not touched)
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English. (the 维护者速读 block is Chinese by repo convention)
- [x] The *Before Submitting* list in CONTRIBUTING.md is done.
